items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: Barbara, Shields, Ragus, and myself. And Edwards. That was the original Vixenland Jazz Band.

ctx.x: Well, I want to get clear. Who was in the band then, at that time, when you made the records for Aeolian?

All the records that were made in New York, the Aeolian, the Colombian, and the Victor, was the original band and types. Barbara, Shields, Ragus, and myself. And Edwards. That was the original Vixenland Jazz Band. All the masterpieces had been made before Edwards was drafted into the Army.
And we can prove that by checking his Army record then. That's right.

items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1960-01-03
items.q: Well, that came in later years after Ragus had died.

ctx.x: Yes, that we know. Now, Nick, let me clarify this. Because remember, you and I are talking as musicians. But the people who are listening to us don't know exactly what we mean. Out of the whole original jazz band that you had in Chicago and later in New York, the only one who could actually read music was the piano player, Russell Robinson.
Well, that came in later years after Ragus had died.

items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-16
items.q: The next day I'd come on the job I'd say to Regis, I'd say, run this over. I'd get the chords on the piano.

ctx.x: You don't see anything in front of me that I take notes from, only just from what comes to my mind. That's why I don't have it in chronological order. I can only tell you what I can think of at the time. Maybe my talk may be gobbled up a little bit, that I might put this one before the other one, the other one before the other one. But I am telling you the true facts of this music. It was in Chicago where I changed the rhythm. They had a certain dance team. They were doing a castle walk. And up in the north,…
Can you hold it a second?

items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Robertson joined us as piano player which he had been the first steady piano player after Regis' death.

ctx.x: I hate to interrupt you on that story but I missed out a couple of things. I didn't get who was in the band at the time. I know Edwards was back. He replaced Christian and I didn't get the names of the other bands.

Now I'll tell you the names of the men. Robertson joined us as piano player which he had been the first steady piano player after Regis' death. We had Shields, myself, Spobara, Edwards and what's his name? Roberts had made the five of us.
And that's immediately upon coming back from London. That's right. Robertson Hilton. And then what was the name of the saxophone players? I want to get that to you.
